name: GoliathCrop
tagline: Crop management on GoliathApp: fields, operations, sensors, imagery, and research trials.
description: GoliathCrop specializes GoliathApp for commercial farms and research stations. Phase 4 adds FAO-56 irrigation scheduling, scouting observations, and phone-usable field entry forms. Phase 3 sensing adds sensor hypertables with dual-activation wakes, Element84 STAC imagery, drone COG processing, and threshold alerts.

features.title: Fields, seasons, and operations
features.description: PostGIS field and plot geometry, plantings by season, and a log of irrigation, fertilization, spraying, and harvest with inputs inventory.

features.title: Sensors, weather, and imagery
features.description: TimescaleDB sensor readings, free weather providers (Open-Meteo, NOAA), and Sentinel-2/Landsat NDVI stored as COGs.

features.title: Research trials in the MVP
features.description: Plots, treatments, replicates, and observations for research stations alongside commercial farm records.

features.title: Irrigation and scouting
features.description: FAO-56 irrigation recommendations from weather and soil moisture, scouting pins with severity and photos, and phone-friendly field entry forms.

features.title: DomainPrograms with dual activation
features.description: Backlog work is claimed through goliath-gateway; event-triggered work (weather, moisture, imagery, thresholds) wakes workers via Postgres pub/sub.
